_meta.title: Master restricted-products reference — all 30 categories, deep detail
_meta.purpose: The comprehensive reference: every Amazon restricted category with status, required docs, trigger keywords, prohibited substances, and marketplace-specific notes. Danger zones (batteries, medical, radio, cosmetics, supplements, hazmat, children's) in full depth; all others at solid category level. Consolidates tier1 + tier2 + tier2b + deep research.
_meta.confidence_note: Compiled from Amazon published policy + regulators (FDA, EPA, FCC, Ofcom, CPSC, MHRA, HSE) + industry compliance references, accurate as of compile date. Amazon updates without notice. Definitive per-ASIN/per-account answer = Seller Central Apply-to-Sell.
_meta.usage_rule: SOURCING ALARM + listing warning. PROHIBITED -> block normal submit (logged force-list only). GATED -> warn + show docs, submit allowed. Never a copy tool: never strip a true spec/ingredient to conceal a restricted product (account-ending).
_meta.marketplace_principle: EU/UK is generally the stricter constraint (esp. cosmetics, children's). Several restrictions are marketplace-specific and must resolve per active marketplace, never globally. Hazmat and category approvals are per-marketplace — approval in one region does NOT carry to another.

merged_from_patch.note: Patch entries carry per-marketplace docs {US:[...],UK:[...]}; listing/restricted.py resolves either shape.

categories.label: Dietary supplements

marketplaces.US: GATED (FDA/FTC)
marketplaces.UK: GATED (FSA/MHRA)

prohibited_ingredients: Ephedra / ephedrine alkaloids (incl. Sida cordifolia / heartleaf sida — Amazon treats plant-sourced ephedrine as prohibited)
hidden pharmaceuticals (sildenafil, tadalafil — common in sexual-enhancement products)
docs: Certificate of Analysis from ISO/IEC 17025-certified lab
amazon_specific_rules: EVERY ingredient claim on the detail page must MATCH the Supplement Facts Panel in name, weight, presentation — 'label-led not marketing-led'. Deactivations for mismatched legacy copy from 2026-03-31.
No 'equivalent raw material' / potency storytelling that exceeds the panel.
Sexual-enhancement & weight-loss supplements CANNOT be sold in single- or double-pill packs (since 2021-12-06).
categories.claims_trap: Any disease claim (diagnose/cure/mitigate/treat/prevent) = unapproved drug = instant restriction.

categories.label: Cosmetics / skincare / topicals

marketplaces.US: GATED (FDA FDCA / MoCRA)
marketplaces.UK: GATED (UK Cosmetics Reg 2020)

prohibited_ingredients_us: Mercury compounds (aliases: Hg, mercuric iodide, mercurous chloride, ammoniated mercury, quicksilver, cinnabaris, hydrargyri oxydum rubrum)
amazon_specific_rules: Separate SKIN-LIGHTENER/whitening policy: requires third-party GMP, heavy-metals + mercury testing, FDA forms 5066 (facility) + 5067 (product). NSF is a named approved tester.
Topicals (anything applied to skin, incl. oils) require approval.
docs: UK/EU: CPSR (signed by qualified assessor) + SCPN(UK)/CPNP(EU) + INCI labelling + Responsible Person
US: FDA registration, GMP, COA, manufacturer invoice (last 180 days)

categories.label: Medical devices & accessories

marketplaces.US: GATED_HARD (FDA)
marketplaces.UK: GATED_HARD (MHRA)

categories.detail: Nebulizers/inhalers = Class II, 510(k), prescription-only, Amazon Professional Healthcare Program only (near-closed for resellers). TENS, blood-pressure monitors, some massagers = Class II OTC. Over-triggers from keywords (beauty/back-strap/snore-guard items get flagged).
docs: US: FDA 510(k) clearance + establishment registration + manufacturer invoice + packaging photos + IFU; prescription devices need Professional Healthcare Program
UK/EU: UKCA(GB)/CE mark + signed Declaration of Conformity under MDR

categories.label: Lithium batteries & products containing them

marketplaces.US: GATED (CPSC/DOT)
marketplaces.UK: GATED (ICAO/IATA)

thresholds: >100Wh: prohibited from standard FBA without special approval
Wh rating MUST match across marketplaces or flagged
categories.scope_trap: Anything with a lithium cell: toothbrushes, speakers, earbuds, toy cars, tools, flashlights. 'If it charges, it's affected.'

categories.label: Radio / wireless / FPV transmitting equipment

marketplaces.UK: 5.8GHz >25mW EIRP = PROHIBITED (Ofcom IR2030); 2.4GHz control >100mW prohibited. Jammers prohibited.
marketplaces.US: 5.8GHz up to 1W legal (FCC Part 15); jammers prohibited; FCC ID/certification required.

categories.detail: High-power FPV VTX is the classic marketplace-split case: 600mW prohibited UK / legal US. Signal jammers prohibited both. Surveillance/hidden-camera restricted.

categories.label: Hazmat / dangerous goods (9 classes)

marketplaces.US: GATED (DOT)
marketplaces.UK: GATED

fba_outcomes: Restricted-dangerous: FBA only if enrolled in Dangerous Goods Program (special centers, higher fees)
Unfulfillable: Class 1 explosives, Class 7 radioactive, Class 6.2 infectious — cannot enter FBA at all
classes: Class 2 (aerosols — every aerosol qualifies due to propellant)
Class 3 flammable liquids (flash point <=60C/140F: perfume, nail polish, lighter fluid, lamp oil)
categories.scope_trap: Aerosols, perfume, nail polish, hand sanitizer, glycolic-acid skincare, magnets (speakers/toys), glue/adhesives, disinfectants all trigger it.
categories.note: Approval is MARKETPLACE-SPECIFIC. Review takes ~4 business days to 2-3 weeks. Certain words in the listing trigger it.

categories.label: Children's products / toys (<=12 yrs)

marketplaces.US: GATED (CPSIA/CPSC)
marketplaces.UK: GATED (UKCA/Toy Safety)

docs_us: Children's Product Certificate (CPC) based on CPSC-accepted third-party lab testing
docs_uk_eu: BS EN 71 / EN 71 (71-1 mechanical, 71-2 flammability, 71-3 toxic elements)
categories.scope: Toys, apparel, jewelry, books, art materials, children's furniture — anything for kids <=12. Amazon usually gives ~30 days to provide CPC; non-compliance = removal even after years listed.

marketplaces.US: RESTRICTED — must comply with TSCA Title VI / CARB Phase 2 formaldehyde standards
marketplaces.UK: Allowed — no equivalent formaldehyde-specific regulation, but general product safety applies

thresholds.testing_standard: ASTM E1333-16 (large chamber) or ASTM D6007 (small chamber)
thresholds.certification: EPA-recognized TSCA Title VI Third-Party Certifier (TPC)

US: TSCA Title VI / CARB Phase 2 certification
Product labeling as TSCA Title VI compliant
UK: No specific formaldehyde regulation but REACH applies

marketplaces.US: GATED — flammability + formaldehyde + tip-over + law label requirements
marketplaces.UK: GATED — Furniture and Furnishings (Fire Safety) Regulations 1988 as amended

US: CARB Phase 2 certification for composite wood components
US Law Label (filling materials, manufacturer info)
UK: Fire Safety Regulations 1988 compliance label (display label + permanent label)

categories.label: Pest control products, pesticides & biocides

marketplaces.US: GATED — EPA registration required under FIFRA
marketplaces.UK: GATED — HSE/CRD registration required under UK BPR (Biocidal Products Regulation)

prohibited_items: Unregistered pesticides (no EPA reg number in US, no HSE/CRD number in UK)
Products making public health claims (kills disease-causing pathogens) without registration
Pesticide products not intended for sale in that marketplace
categories.false_positive_warning: NON-pesticide products get flagged constantly by Amazon's automated scanner when listing copy contains ANY of the trigger keywords. A cleaning cloth described as 'antibacterial' or oil described as 'anti-corrosion' can trigger a pesticide review. This is the MOST COMMON source of false-positive Restricted Product violations for arbitrage/reselling sellers. The claims screener must catch these words regardless of product category.
your_violations: Mil-Gear lubricant flagged for pesticide-claim language in listing copy (v8 session)

categories.label: Opaque / light-blocking eyewear & goggles

marketplaces.US: PROHIBITED — FDA considers non-transparent eyewear a medical device risk
marketplaces.UK: RESTRICTED — general product safety, PPE Regulation 2016/425 if marketed as protective

your_violations: B0H4NJN5BM — opaque light-blocking goggles/eyeshields, PROHIBITED (FDA requires see-through eyewear)

marketplaces.US: PROHIBITED except pre-approved wine sellers; beer/spirits fully prohibited
marketplaces.UK: RESTRICTED — alcohol listings allowed with age verification; must comply with Licensing Act 2003

categories.label: Explosives, weapons & related items

marketplaces.US: PROHIBITED — firearms, ammunition, explosives, fireworks; some non-lethal accessories allowed
marketplaces.UK: PROHIBITED — Firearms Act 1968, Explosives Regulations 2014

prohibited_items: All firearms and firearm parts (receivers, frames, triggers, silencers, bump stocks)
Explosives and fireworks of any kind
Disguised weapons (pen knives designed as weapons, credit card knives)
allowed_exceptions: Gun safes and cabinets
Cleaning kits (non-specific)
Hunting accessories (scopes, bipods — varies by marketplace)
Airsoft guns (UK: with orange tip, age-restricted)

categories.label: Drugs, OTC medicines & drug paraphernalia

marketplaces.US: GATED — OTC drugs must have FDA Drug Facts label; prescription drugs PROHIBITED
marketplaces.UK: GATED — OTC medicines via MHRA registered sellers only; pharmacy-only medicines (P) require registered pharmacy; prescription-only (POM) PROHIBITED

prohibited_items: Controlled substances (Schedule I-V US, Class A-C UK)
Drug paraphernalia (bongs, dab rigs, purity test kits, crack pipes)
Products containing scheduled substances (codeine, ephedrine above thresholds)

UK: MHRA registration as online seller of medicines
THR (Traditional Herbal Registration) number if herbal

categories.label: CBD / hemp / cannabis

marketplaces.US: CBD PROHIBITED outright: 'Listings for products containing cannabidiol (CBD) are prohibited.' Only hemp SEED products (hulled seeds, seed protein, seed oil — no cannabinoids) allowed.
marketplaces.UK: Ingestible CBD/cannabinoid products (oils, gummies, e-liquids, sprays, lozenges) PROHIBITED except an invite-only pilot NOT accepting sellers. Only cold-pressed hemp SEED oil allowed. THC cap 1mg/container (controlled substance). Novel-food FSA approval pending.

categories.concealment_trap: CRITICAL: sellers list CBD as 'Hemp Extract'/'Hemp Oil' to dodge the CBD keyword ban. This is exactly the concealment pattern that is account-ending. The app must NOT suggest or enable relabelling CBD as hemp to bypass the ban. If a product IS CBD, it's prohibited — don't sell it, don't disguise it.
allowed: hemp seed oil (cold-pressed, from seeds only)
categories.regulator: FDA (US) / MHRA-FSA-Home Office (UK, Misuse of Drugs Act 1971)

categories.label: Weapons, firearms, ammunition, knives

marketplaces.UK: Kitchen/chef's knives & ANY age-verification bladed article CANNOT be listed via FBM (seller-fulfilled) on Amazon.co.uk since 2022-05-19 (Offensive Weapons Act 2019). FBA-only for eligible blades. Zombie/flick/butterfly knives = PROHIBITED outright (illegal any age). Combat framing prohibited (Knives Act 1997). 2026 Crime & Policing Act ('Ronan's Law'): two-point identity age verification + bulk-sale reporting (6+ blades to police).
marketplaces.US: Firearms/ammunition prohibited. Automatic/switchblade/concealed knives prohibited. Ordinary knives allowed.

categories.note: UK is far stricter. A kitchen knife is legal but FBM-prohibited on Amazon UK. Marketing ANY knife for 'combat' is an offence.
categories.regulator: UK: Offensive Weapons Act 2019 / Criminal Justice Act 1988 / Knives Act 1997

categories.label: Laser products / pointers

marketplaces.US: Limited to Class 3R (<=5mW), must be branded. Class 3B & Class 4 barred. Handheld pointers generally not allowed.
marketplaces.UK: Consumer products restricted to Class 1 or Class 2 (stricter). OPSS has removed Class 3/4 lasers from Amazon UK.

thresholds: UK: Class 1 or 2 only for consumers
docs: US: FDA accession number + testing report from Intertek/UL/SGS + brand
list of laser ASINs + seller info

categories.label: Plant & seed products

marketplaces.US: USDA import restrictions; invasive/noxious species prohibited; some seeds need phytosanitary certs.
marketplaces.UK: Post-Brexit: EU/third-country plant & seed imports require PHYTOSANITARY CERTIFICATES; some species prohibited; hemp seed needs Home Office context.

requirements: live Christmas trees & greenery need certification
categories.note: Distinct from hemp/CBD (separate entry). Watch invasive-species lists per marketplace.

categories.label: Lighting products (bulbs, lamps)

marketplaces.US: General service lamps must meet 45 lumens/watt (DOE, 10 CFR 429/430/431). Non-compliant incandescent/halogen PROHIBITED. Full enforcement since Aug 2023. Lighting Facts label (FTC) required on medium screw-base.
marketplaces.UK/EU: Incandescent + halogen bulbs BANNED from Amazon sale since 2021-10-01 (specific wattages: 15/25/40/60/75/100W clear incandescent, frosted incandescent, halogen except R7/G9/GU5.3/G4/GY6.35 sockets). EU energy-efficiency labelling required.

prohibited: incandescent adapters without medium screw base

categories.label: Lock picking & theft devices
categories.note: Prohibited: lock-pick sets, slim-jims, tension bars, key-duplication devices, Sensormatic detachers, card-skimming devices, code grabbers, shoplifting/booster devices. ALLOWED: blank keys only.

categories.label: Surveillance / spy equipment
categories.note: PROHIBITED: covert/eavesdropping devices, devices to intercept conversations, signal jammers. ALLOWED: baby monitors, non-eavesdropping security cameras.

categories.label: Food, beverages, grocery

marketplaces.US: GATED (FDA/USDA)
marketplaces.UK: GATED (FSA)

requirements: Expiration date PERMANENTLY marked on every unit (set is_expiration_dated_product=true in inventory template)
Sesame must be declared (9th US allergen, FASTER Act 2023)
FDA RACC serving sizes (21 CFR 101.12) mandatory — foreign serving sizes void the Nutrition Facts panel (#1 import error)
FSVP program if importer of record (FDA can demand records in 24h)
English labelling: name, net weight, ingredients, allergens, nutrition, manufacturer

categories.label: Jewelry & precious gems
categories.note: Fine jewelry gated for anti-fraud/quality. Requires establishing account history.

categories.label: Refrigerants / ozone-depleting substances

marketplaces.US: Can ONLY be sold to EPA Section 608/609 certified technicians (40 CFR 82 Subpart F, Clean Air Act). Effectively closed to general buyers.
marketplaces.UK: F-gas regulated

categories.exception: Small cans of R-134a substitute for motor-vehicle AC.

categories.label: Automotive & powersports
categories.note: Top-level open, but: EMISSIONS DEFEAT DEVICES prohibited (Title II Clean Air Act) — tuners/deletes removed even WITH CARB EO docs. Tires/wheels/rims = separate gate. Parts needing EPA Certificate of Conformity gated. Products must retain full OBD/emissions functionality.

categories.label: Fine art

marketplaces.US: GATED — Amazon Fine Art Store requires pre-approval
marketplaces.UK: GATED — same approval requirements

prohibited_items: NFT-linked physical art without proper rights documentation

UK: Artist Resale Right compliance (droit de suite) for secondary sales of works by living/recently deceased artists

categories.label: Currency, coins, cash equivalents & gift cards

marketplaces.US: GATED — Collectible Coins requires pre-approval; counterfeit/altered currency PROHIBITED
marketplaces.UK: GATED — same rules; Forgery and Counterfeiting Act 1981

prohibited_items: Commemorative medals misrepresented as legal tender

categories.label: Tobacco, e-cigarettes & vaping products

marketplaces.US: PROHIBITED — all tobacco, nicotine, e-cigarettes, vaping devices, e-liquids
marketplaces.UK: MOSTLY PROHIBITED — nicotine e-liquids prohibited; nicotine-free e-cigarette devices allowed with safety compliance; all tobacco products prohibited

prohibited_items: All tobacco products (cigarettes, cigars, pipe tobacco, chewing tobacco, snuff, snus)
All nicotine-containing e-liquids and refill cartridges
E-cigarette devices (US — all; UK — only if nicotine-containing)
Herbal cigarettes / herbal smoking mix containing tobacco or nicotine

US: FDA-approved nicotine replacement therapy (patches, gum, lozenges) — but GATED under drugs_otc
UK: Nicotine-free e-cigarette devices (must comply with safety standards)
Smoking cessation products approved by MHRA
Vaping accessories (cases, stands) that contain no nicotine/tobacco

UK_nicotine_free_devices: MHRA notification (must appear on MHRA Notified Products list)

categories.label: Animals & animal-related products

marketplaces.US: RESTRICTED — live animals prohibited except certain aquarium species, insects, shellfish
marketplaces.UK: RESTRICTED — live animals prohibited; CITES applies to endangered species products

prohibited_items: Live animals (except aquarium species, certain insects, shellfish/crustaceans in US)
Products containing ivory from any animal
Products from endangered/CITES-listed species (rhinoceros, tiger, pangolin, etc.)
Shark fins, whale meat, dolphin/porpoise parts
Tools for ear cropping, tail docking, declawing
Products violating Lacey Act / Migratory Bird Treaty Act
Real fur products (California ban applies to Amazon US)
allowed_exceptions: Faux/synthetic animal products
Ethically sourced leather goods (must prove legal sourcing on request)
Pet food and treats (FDA compliant, separate gating)
Brine shrimp / sea monkey hatch kits (shipped dry/dormant)
Live worms and live bait

US: Lacey Act declaration for plant/animal materials
Certificate of legal sourcing on request
UK: Control of Trade in Endangered Species Regulations

categories.label: Recalled products
categories.detail: Any product subject to a recall by CPSC (US), OPSS (UK), or RAPEX (EU) is PROHIBITED. Amazon actively scans for recalled ASINs and removes them. Sellers listing recalled products face immediate listing removal and potential account suspension. Check CPSC.gov (US), product-safety-alerts.beis.gov.uk (UK), and Safety Gate RAPEX (EU) before sourcing.

US: Product not on active recall list
UK: Product not on active recall list

categories.label: Gambling & lottery
allowed_exceptions: Non-functional slot machines for display/decoration
Toy slot machines (clearly marketed as toys)
Card game supplies (poker chips, playing cards)
Board games involving fictional gambling mechanics

categories.label: Warranties, service plans & contracts
categories.detail: Only Amazon-authorized providers can list warranties and service plans. Third-party sellers cannot list standalone warranty products without Amazon's pre-approval. Product warranties included with physical products (manufacturer warranty) are fine — it's standalone warranty-as-a-product listings that are restricted.

UK: Same; must also comply with Consumer Rights Act 2015

marketplaces.US: RESTRICTED — state e-waste laws vary; some states require recycling programs
marketplaces.UK: RESTRICTED — WEEE Regulations 2013; producers must register with approved compliance scheme

UK: WEEE producer registration with Environment Agency

categories.label: Postage meters & stamps
allowed_exceptions: Collectible stamps (philately — with approval)
Used/cancelled stamps for collection
Stamp albums and accessories

categories.label: Offensive & controversial materials
categories.detail: Amazon reserves the right to determine what is offensive. Products promoting hatred, violence, racial/religious/sexual intolerance, or glorifying human suffering are prohibited. This includes but is not limited to: hate group merchandise, crime scene photos, products trivializing human tragedies, and products promoting illegal activity. Amazon's determination is final and subjective.
prohibited_items: Products promoting hatred or violence against any group
Products glorifying human suffering or tragedies
Products with profane or vulgar content (marketplace-dependent)

categories.label: Strike anywhere matches
categories.detail: Amazon prohibits all strike-anywhere matches — matches that can be ignited by friction against any rough surface, not just a designated striker. Safety matches (requiring the specific striker on the box) are allowed but classified as hazmat for shipping and require FBA dangerous goods enrollment.
allowed_exceptions: Safety matches (FBA dangerous goods program required)

categories.label: CPAP cleaning & disinfecting devices
categories.detail: The FDA has NOT approved or cleared any ozone-gas or UV-light device for cleaning CPAP equipment. The FDA communicated directly to Amazon that these are unapproved medical devices. Both ozone and UV CPAP cleaners are PROHIBITED regardless of brand. CPAP machines themselves (the breathing devices) require 510(k) clearance and fall under medical_devices.
prohibited_items: Any device marketed to clean/sanitize/disinfect CPAP equipment

categories.label: Polystyrene foam (state-level restrictions)

marketplaces.US: RESTRICTED in some states — Washington, Maine, Maryland, others ban expanded polystyrene food containers
marketplaces.UK: No specific ban but general single-use plastics restrictions apply

categories.detail: Several US states ban expanded polystyrene (EPS) foam food service containers. Amazon may restrict listings that ship to those states. Not a federal ban but state-level enforcement varies. Most relevant for food service packaging sellers.

categories.label: Electronics (general)

marketplaces.US: GATED for some subcategories — FCC compliance required for RF-emitting devices
marketplaces.UK: GATED — UKCA/CE marking, EMC Regulations, LVD, RoHS, WEEE

prohibited_items: Devices that bypass copyright protection (mod chips, circumvention devices)
Radar detectors (some US states / UK prohibited in use)
Devices interfering with other devices' radio frequency

UK: UKCA marking (or CE until transitional period ends)

categories.label: Human parts & burial artifacts
prohibited_items: Human body parts, organs, remains, waste, or fluids
Historical grave markers from protected lands
Artifacts taken from protected archaeological sites
allowed_exceptions: Human skulls, bones, and skeletons for medical/educational use (where permitted by local law)
Human hair products including wigs
Dental/medical models (synthetic)

categories.label: Export controls
categories.detail: Products subject to US Export Administration Regulations (EAR), International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), or UK Export Control Act 2002 may not be sold to certain countries/entities. Amazon prohibits products from sanctioned countries (North Korea, Cuba, Syria, Iran, Crimea, DNR/LNR). Encryption software, military/dual-use technology, and certain advanced electronics fall under export controls.
prohibited_items: Products from North Korea, Cuba, Syria, Iran, Crimea, DNR/LNR
EAR-controlled dual-use items without proper classification

categories.label: Art — Home decor
categories.detail: Home decor art is less restricted than fine art but must not infringe intellectual property. Wall decals, murals, and decorative art that reproduce copyrighted images without license are prohibited. Original designs and properly licensed reproductions are allowed.
prohibited_items: Items infringing on character/brand IP (Disney, Marvel, etc.)

categories.label: Subscriptions & periodicals
categories.detail: Subscription products and periodicals require Amazon approval. Auto-renewing subscriptions must comply with consumer protection rules around clear pricing, cancellation rights, and billing transparency. Subscribe & Save is Amazon's own program with separate enrollment.

UK: Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013 compliance (14-day cancellation right)

categories.label: Prohibited product claims (cross-category)
categories.detail: This is NOT a product category — it's a CROSS-CUTTING policy. Amazon prohibits certain CLAIMS in listing copy regardless of product category. These claims trigger automated scanning and can result in Restricted Product violations even on perfectly legal products. This is the single biggest source of false-positive violations for sellers.

categories.label: Electric heating appliances (space heaters, patio heaters, fan heaters)

marketplaces.US: GATED — UL/ETL certification required, FCC if wireless
marketplaces.UK: GATED — BS EN 60335-2-30 test report required, UKCA DoC, UK Responsible Person. OPSS actively enforces on Amazon UK. High-risk category.

UK: Test report from ISO 17025 lab to BS EN 60335-2-30
IP rating test evidence if IP rating claimed in listing

categories.false_positive_warning: Amazon's classifier is aggressive on this category. Even hot water heating appliances get wrongly classified as electric space heaters. Any product with 'heater' in the title risks triggering a proactive compliance request.
your_violations: B0HCJK9YKH — 2000W Electric Patio Heater, Food and Product Safety Issues, 11 Aug 2026, deadline 10 Oct 2026

cross_cutting.claims_to_regulated_conversion: Three categories flip via COPY not product: supplement disease-claims -> drug; cosmetic anti-acne/SPF/antibacterial -> drug; any product kill/sanitize/antimicrobial -> pesticide. These overlap the claims screener.
cross_cutting.keyword_over_triggering: Amazon's automated classifiers over-trigger from title/bullet/review keywords (medical-device, pesticide, hazmat). A clean product with the wrong word gets pulled into a restricted bucket.
cross_cutting.no_match_not_safe: Absence from this list is NOT a clearance. Subcategory gating and account-specific gating only resolve via Seller Central Apply-to-Sell.
cross_cutting.enforcement_timing: Often post-listing: created fine, removed/flagged weeks later. Notice windows typically 14-30 days to provide docs.
still_needed_from_login: Amazon's verbatim per-category sub-page text (G200164330 children)
account-specific gating status per account (Apple/Nike-style brand gating)
full supplement prohibited-ingredient list as Amazon publishes it
